##


**Things You Need To Know About Dandy’s World Characters**


#


Dandy’s World characters list includes around 40[playable Toons](https://dandys-world-robloxhorror.fandom.com/wiki/Toons) , split into distinct roles based on their rarity, costs, and stats. New players start by picking one of two free Toons, Boxten or Poppy.


In the Dandy’s World community, building a “Toonsona”, an original character designed to fit the game’s retro universe, is one of the biggest fan art trends going. Main characters like Dandy, Vee or Astro are usually treated as their go-to blueprint and inspiration for creating their original characters (OCs), like a Dandy’s World Astro OC or a Dandy’s World Vee OC. These OCs typically reflect their distinct personalities or develop unique stories that involve interactions with the rest of the cast.


*in Dandy’s World, each Toon feels like a genuine character with its own unique stats, perks, and visual charm*

Regular Toons Regular The other 23 Toons bought in Dandy’s Store, including Blot, Brightney, Cosmo, Flutter, Gigi, Rodger, and Tisha.


Event Toons Event The rest of the seasonal cast beyond Bassie, Bobette, and Gourdy: Cocoa, Eggson, Flyte, Eclipse, Ribecca, Soulvester, Coal, Ginger, and Rudie.


Every Toon has a matching **Twisted form** , the monstrous version that hunts players on the floors below the factory, with a different one rotated onto the game’s Twisted Board each day. The list of Dandy’s World characters is still growing through regular updates and 2026 merchandise drops, as an abundant source of inspiration for fans to create their own characters.

##


**FAQ**


#


###


**Who is Dandy in Dandy’s World?**


#


[Dandy](https://dandys-world-robloxhorror.fandom.com/wiki/Dandy) is the mascot who runs the candy factory where the whole game takes place, and the character the Lethal-tier Dandy Toon is themed around. Long-time lore ties him to Astro through a shared history at the factory before it turned dangerous, part of why the two share one of the more detailed dialogue threads in the game.


###


What is Redbean? Is it an official Dandy’s World OC maker?


#


BlushCrunch Studio hasn’t released an official Dandy’s World Characters maker, so what’s out there are fan-made template tools. **Redbean** is a free mobile sandbox for iOS and Android where you can recreate a pixel version of Dandy, Shelly, or Cosmo, or[build original characters entirely your own](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/free-cozy-life-sim-with-your-own-characters) , and then bring it to life instead of leaving it as a static image like most other OC makers. You get your own town, characters you can talk to, and complete creative freedom to build any concept and narratives for your favorite Toons.


*Redbean isn’t affiliated with BlushCrunch Studio. It’s a playground for fans to build their own version of the Toons they already love.*


###


How can I bring my Dandy’s World OC into Redbean?


#


If you already made your OC in another Dandy’s World OC Maker tool, a sketch, or fan art, you can just upload that image to Redbean and it generates a pixel version you can actually play with: walk it around town, hold a conversation, and watch it interact with other residents who you can also create yourself, including Astro, Cosmo, other characters like Jax (TADC) or Ratthew (Animal Hospital). What was a static image actually becomes a playable character with a persona, trait, a place to live in, and its own story that only you can write.


###


**What’s the difference between a Toon and its Twisted form?**


#


A Toon is the friendly, playable version of a character; its Twisted form is the monstrous form that hunts Toons through the factory floors. Every character has both, and the game rotates a different one onto the Twisted Board each day. Some fans use Twisted forms as inspiration for a darker Dandy’s World AU redesign of their own OCs.
